verses.text: For I believed in the Lord’s Christ, and He appeared unto me, even He who is the Lord;
And He shewed me His sign, led me by His light, and gave me the rod of His power,
That I might subdue the imaginations of the peoples, and bring low the power of mighty men;
To make war by His Word, and to take victory by His power.
And the Lord overthrew my enemy by His word: and he became like the stubble which the wind carrieth away;

section: And He Appeared to Me, the One Who Is the Lord
